findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_subscription_tool" references sensitive artifacts (credentials, api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Check your MCP subscription status and remaining quota. Uses credentials from the request if api_key omitted.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_document_tool, purchase_plan_tool · Private data: get_document_cost_tool, get_document_tool, list_monitored_cases_tool, get_case_status_tool, check_subscription_tool · Public sink: purchase_plan_tool · Destructive: get_case_by_case_number_tool.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_document_tool, purchase_plan_tool · Private data: get_document_cost_tool, get_document_tool, list_monitored_cases_tool, get_case_status_tool, check_subscription_tool · Public sink: purchase_plan_tool · Destructive: get_case_by_case_number_tool

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
